# Meddleware documentation

> User documentation for Meddleware's permissionless, wallet-based tools on Sui and Walrus. No accounts: every tool works with a connected Sui wallet, and the on-chain packages are the source of truth.

The full text of this site in one file: [llms-full.txt](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/llms-full.txt). Developer documentation (SDKs, PTB patterns, integration, self-hosting): [dev.meddleware.co.uk/llms.txt](https://dev.meddleware.co.uk/llms.txt).

## Start here

- [Overview](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/)
- [Getting started on Sui](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/getting-started)
- [How the tools fit together](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/architecture)

## Tools

- [Walrus Storage](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/walrus-storage/): upload files to Walrus, manage their lifetime ([walkthrough](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/walrus-storage/walkthrough), [reference](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/walrus-storage/reference))
- [Sealed Storage](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/sealed-storage/): encrypt with Seal, store on Walrus ([policies](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/sealed-storage/policies), [walkthrough](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/sealed-storage/walkthrough), [reference](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/sealed-storage/reference))
- [Access Gate](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/access-gate/): NFT access passes ([walkthrough](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/access-gate/walkthrough), [reference](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/access-gate/reference))
- [Token Issuance](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/onchain/token-issuance/overview): issue a Sui coin ([user guide](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/onchain/token-issuance/user-guide))
- [Treasury](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/treasury/): the platform's on-chain revenue, read-only ([reference](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/treasury/reference))

## On-chain packages

- [access_gate overview](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/onchain/access-gate/overview), [user guide](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/onchain/access-gate/user-guide)
- [sealed_storage overview](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/onchain/sealed-storage/overview), [user guide](https://docs.meddleware.co.uk/blockchain/sui/onchain/sealed-storage/user-guide)
